title: Yummy Canadian Maple Wrap
description: A resinous, molten brunch dish that blends maple sweetness with savory smoked salmon wrapped in lotus leaf.
instructions: Rinse lotus leaves and pat dry.
Warm each leaf on a hot skillet for 10 seconds to make pliable.
Spread 1/4 cup cooked wild rice over the center of each leaf.
Arrange slices of smoked salmon, cucumber, avocado, and a drizzle of maple syrup on top of the rice.
Sprinkle 1/2 tsp celery salt and a dash of lemon juice over the filling.
Fold the sides of the leaf over and roll tightly, securing with a toothpick if desired.
Place the wraps seam-side down on a steaming pan and cook for 3 minutes to meld flavors.
Remove from heat, let cool for a minute, then slice the wrap lengthwise and serve warm.
